anchors.basis: Core lawAnchorOutcome over the routing ledger (owner corrections applied): each judged law outcome counted once per skill of its receipt at its band, keyed by the skill variant and the row that ran (model@effort; Core lawAnchor reads the failure rate the anchor implies for that row from its capability gap); an older receipt read from its reading by the policy's skill rules

owner_judged.basis: Core lawOwnerJudgedOutcome over the routing ledger: the delivered answers of requests the law read as subjective (the owner the judge), failed when the owner corrected them or they were not delivered

screen.basis: Core lawScreenOutcome over the routing ledger: the structural screen (descentStructurallySound) of every screened law, graded or capability descent and every law-bound reference answer's shadow screen, keyed model@effort, pooled over families and surfaces

source.basis: Core lawJudgedOutcome over the routing ledger: judged laddered descents (route kinds tier, graded, capability, law), not escalated, keyed by the law family of their receipt; a local draft by its REVAS check verdict only; failure = escalated, not returned, verifier, check or REVAS fail (class full: no deliverable draft); success = verifier, check or REVAS pass
